Methodology

How a vendor earns its grade.

Anonymous procurement. Every sample was bought off-the-shelf at a normal shipping address. Vendors do not know which orders are ours. They cannot send us a "good" lot.

HPLC-UV identity & purity. Every sample runs on a C18 reverse-phase column at 214 nm. Identity is confirmed against a reference standard. Purity is the sample peak as a percentage of total integrated area.

Composite score. Each test scores 0–10 on purity, identity confidence, and label-claim deviation. A vendor needs six tests across two products before we assign a letter grade. Below that bar, the vendor stays unrated.

No paid promotion. We do not accept free samples or sponsorships from any vendor on this page. Vendors cannot pay to remove a low score or delay a result.
